newsitem.title: USA: SBC Warburg NY's DeRosa departs to start new fund.
newsitem.headline: SBC Warburg NY's DeRosa departs to start new fund.

text.p: David DeRosa, a director of foreign exchange trading at SBC Warburg, said he resigned from the bank on Friday to become managing partner at Quadrangle Investments LLC, a new private hedge fund based in Greenwich, Conn.
DeRosa told Reuters his new firm will exist as of Monday, September 16.
He said Quadrangle has start-up capital but will be a closed fund. DeRosa said he plans to invest across all major markets.
"I want to stress that I'm not looking for new investors; it's a private hedge fund," DeRosa said.
In addition, DeRosa said he will soon also be joining the staff of Yale University as an adjunct professor of finance.
